image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a black hockey puck resting on a reflective surface (likely ice or glass). The puck features a prominent blue and gold triangular logo on its top face. There are significant visual artifacts surrounding the puck, appearing as shattered glass shards, light refractions, and ghostly double-images of the puck's edge, suggesting a dynamic impact or a digital glitch.
